title: potentilla crocea
intro: Potentilla crocea, commonly known as the Orange Dwarf Cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla crocea include its ability to act as an anti-cancer agent, anti-inflammatory agent, and antioxidant agent, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are found in its leaves, stems, and roots.
